verdict.rationale: TruffleHog is documented as a secrets scanner that digs into code repositories. It ships git and GitHub scan commands, such as `trufflehog git file://.` and `trufflehog github --repo`, with commit-range control via `--since-commit`, and it classifies and verifies more than 800 secret types. Commit-level scanning is implied by the git source and the `--since-commit` flag, and community discussion of finding deleted commits touches history coverage. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation that a default scan covers every commit and branch, and independent hands-on confirmation of full-history scan results.
